item.title: Azerbaijan tallies volume of transactions with local cards in Jan. 2026
item.description: In Azerbaijan, the use of local payment cards saw a notable increase in January 2026. The number of transactions and their total volume both grew compared to the previous year. This rise reflects a positive trend in the country's financial activity.
